blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Your dog can’t empty their anal glands…
blocks_element.text: Your dog can’t empty their anal glands properly. They're meant to empty naturally every time your dog poos, squeezed by the pressure of a firm stool. When stools are too soft or loose, that pressure isn't there. The glands get full and uncomfortable, and your dog starts scooting and licking to find relief.
